memory.title: JWT clock skew
memory.body: Tokens minted by the IdP were rejected as not-yet-valid; allow 60s leeway on nbf/iat.

args.title: Fresh tokens rejected right after login
args.body: Login then immediate API call failed with 'token not active'; the IdP clock runs a few seconds ahead. Added leeway to the validator.

cases.why: same path and topic words, different fact

args.title: JWT signing key rotation
args.body: JWKS keys rotate weekly; the validator caches JWKS for 1h and refetches on unknown kid.
